name: Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512
access: Hugging Face weights FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 (base and RL language-model checkpoints in one repository) and ModelScope
FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice repository: Python, vLLM and TensorRT-LLM serving, FastAPI and gRPC servers

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio hosts CosyVoice v3 and v3.5 models (cosyvoice-v3-plus, cosyvoice-v3-flash, cosyvoice-v3.5-plus, cosyvoice-v3.5-flash) in the Beijing region; the docs do not say they are these weights

voice.input_audio: Text, a short reference clip, and an instruction written as a prefix of the form 'You are a helpful assistant. <instruction><|endofprompt|>'; inline tags in the text [cosy-example]
voice.output_audio: A waveform tensor with the model's sample rate, saved by the caller; streaming chunks are supported [cosy-example]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a reference clip; no preset voices in this release [cosy-gh]
languages: 9 languages (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian) and 18+ Chinese dialects and accents [cosy-gh]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: Alibaba's README states latency as low as 150 ms in bi-streaming mode (text in and audio out streaming) [cosy-gh]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, no price. A GPU is the expected target; the README gives no memory figure [cosy-gh]

benchmarks.name: test-zh character error rate, base checkpoint (lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: Alibaba's table; the RL checkpoint scores 0.81; this measures content accuracy, not instruction following

benchmarks.name: test-en word error rate, base checkpoint (lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: Alibaba's table; the RL checkpoint scores 1.68

unknown: released: the Hugging Face repository was created 2025-12-11 and the README roadmap lists the release for 2025-12 [hf-cosy3-api] [cosy-gh]
hardware: the sources give no GPU memory figure
context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; the limits are in characters, seconds or tokens of audio, see voice.session_limit
max_output: not applicable to a synthesis model
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs, or the open weights carry no price; see notes
system_card: the maker publishes no system card; the model card on the weights page is the nearest document
